root_cause.text: The error handling in `create_space_info()` calls `kfree(space_info)` after `btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type()` has already freed `space_info` via `kobject_put()` -> `space_info_release()` -> `kfree()` on failure, resulting in a double free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly describes the double-free call chain: `create_space_info() -> btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() -> kobject_init_and_add() fails -> kobject_put(&space_info->kobj) -> space_info_release() -> kfree(space_info); then control returns and `goto out_free` leads to another `kfree(space_info)`. The patch changes the error branch from `goto out_free` to `return ret`, preventing the second free.
